results.title: Croatia 2026 World Cup Preview & Betting Odds
highlights:
Welcome to your ultimate Croatia 2026 World Cup tournament preview. We are breaking down everything Canadian soccer bettors need to know before putting their hard-earned money down on the Vatreni this summer. Despite a population of just under four million, this European powerhouse consistently punches far above its weight on the international stage. While their golden generation is undoubtedly ageing, our top Croatia World Cup prediction points toward another resilient run, making them a cheeky value bet to comfortably advance past the group stage and into the knockout rounds.
[...]
We project Croatia to successfully navigate Group L, ultimately bowing out in the Round of 16. While Zlatko Dalić’s squad boasts incredible pedigree, an expected knockout-stage clash with a powerhouse like Spain might prove too steep a mountain to climb.
[...]
Best Bet: Croatia to reach the Round of 16. The value here is solid, especially with Bet99 offering competitive odds on their exact stage of elimination.
[...]
| To Reach the Stage | Projected Chance |
| --- | --- |
| Winner | 0.2% |
| Final | 0.9% |
| Semi Final | 3.7% |
| Quarter Final | 11.3% |
| Round of 16 | 39.0% |
| Round of 32 | 82.1% |
[...]
When diving into the Croatia World Cup Odds, you have to respect their pedigree. They secured a silver medal eight years ago and a bronze four years later, proving they are never a team to be slept on. During their recent UEFA qualification campaign, they absolutely dominated Group L, racking up 22 points and outscoring opponents 26-4. That is a staggering 3.25 goals per game, showcasing plenty of offensive firepower.
[...]
Their biggest strength remains their midfield composure and defensive solidity. During a crucial away fixture against Czechia in qualifying, they held the hosts to a measly 0.70 expected goals against (xGA) to grind out a scoreless draw. On the flip side, their primary weakness is undoubtedly their age. The core group that carried them to back-to-back podium finishes is in its twilight.
[...]
While younger talents like Manchester City standout Joško Gvardiol bring fresh athleticism to the backline, bettors must weigh whether this ageing squad can handle the gruelling schedule. Bookmakers currently have them priced as joint-16th favourites in the outright winner market, signalling that a regression is likely on the horizon.
[...]
The Vatreni bring unmatched experience and tactical discipline to the 2026 tournament. While their ageing roster might struggle against elite transitional speed, our Croatia World Cup Prediction remains confident they will punch their ticket to the Round of 16. Keep an eye out for more comprehensive team previews and betting insights right here at Canada Sports Betting.

results.title: Croatia World Cup 2026 Odds, Predictions & Best Bets - Yahoo Sports
highlights:
At 90/1 to lift the trophy in North America, Croatia sit 18th in the outright market and are firmly in the territory of realistic dark horses rather than genuine favourites. That price is not an insult to a nation that reached the 2018 final and claimed third place four years later; it simply reflects the depth of the 2026 field and the advancing age of a squad that must produce across multiple knockout rounds to repeat those feats. For bettors who believe in this group of players one last time, the Croatia World Cup odds carry genuine appeal in alternative markets even if the outright feels a stretch.
[...]
The expanded 48-team format means an additional round before the familiar Round of 16, but Croatia's tournament experience should make the early knockout rounds feel routine. The real test arrives in the quarterfinals, where a potential clash with one of South America's heavyweights or a top European side awaits. It is at that stage where Croatia's 90/1 outright odds begin to look more realistic as a ceiling than a floor; matching up with Brazil, Argentina, France or Spain in a straight knockout game is a significant ask of an ageing squad.
[...]
Outright Winner (90/1): Croatia are 18th in a 48-team market at the best available price. A legitimate long shot rather than a genuine contender, but not without logic given their knockout-round pedigree.
[...]
A group containing England, Panama and Ghana is navigable. Croatia qualified for this tournament with a record of 7 wins, 1 draw and no losses in eight matches, scoring 26 goals and conceding just 4. That form does not disappear overnight. Livaković in goal, Gvardiol in defence, and Modrić in midfield give them a platform to handle the Round of 32 and Round of 16 comfortably. The quarter-final is where the strength of the draw becomes decisive, and at that stage a big price on progression is available. This is the bet that makes most sense given the evidence at hand and the Croatia World Cup predictions that paint them as a genuine top-eight side.
[...]
For betting, futures markets on Croatia World Cup 2026 odds are available at leading operators right now, with outright and group winner prices already live. Prices will move as the tournament progresses and squad news emerges; injury updates, particularly any developments around Modrić's fitness ahead of the England game, are the most likely catalysts for significant line movement. Locking in stage-of-elimination or group qualifier prices before the opening fixtures can offer better value than waiting, particularly if Croatia start the tournament strongly.
